newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal plans Nov diesel, kerosene tender next week.
newsitem.headline: Nepal plans Nov diesel, kerosene tender next week.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) plans to issue a tender next week to buy high speed diesel and superior kerosene for November delivery, an NOC source said on Wednesday.

The tender would seek 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for November 1-10 delivery and 30,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for November 11-20 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to the Indian east coast, he said.
The tender was expected to close on October 7-8, he said.
Nepal has another kerosene purchase tender which closed on September 24 and is expected to be awarded later on Wednesday.
The best offer in this tender, which seeks 30,000 tonnes for October 1-15 delivery, is around $245 per tonne, c-and-f Indian east coast.
